load_bearing_for: host_specific.json is loaded by core's CMDB loader, which now validates every entry first and installs nothing if any one is invalid (operator ruling R13): a skipped entry would leave the interlock it names, and the services it guards, ungated
the loader's null validation relies on B-20's null guards (87490bb8f), which here refuse the whole file instead of skipping the entry
registers: B-5b (replaced: this is the all-or-nothing loader, not 8f0076b81's per-entry skip)
B-20 (load-bearing: its null guards, as a refusal of the file; 87490bb8f)
patches.requires: libntech patches 0005 and 0006 (B-24): the loader parses host_specific.json with JsonParseFileStrict(). Known difference from the pinned fork (decided 2026-11-17 to keep; issue 71): libntech B-4/B-10 and core's rlist.c number fix are not in the overlay, so a top-level CMDB scalar or primitive array holding 1e5 or an integer past long makes cf-agent exit in the install step (StringToLongExitOnError), and a real installs as %.2f; the projector refuses floats and writes no exponents, so only a hand-edited file reaches it (upstream-overlay.md section 7; issue 71)
